institution: ABV-IIITM Gwalior (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management, Gwalior)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: ~90% placement rate; average package around 15 LPA; highest package reported at 52 LPA; recruiters include Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Flipkart, Amazon.
AC classrooms and hallways, squash and badminton courts, centralized library, 24/7 free medical facilities, strong campus-wide wifi.
Strong alumni network active through clubs like IEEE; notable alumni in leadership roles at KPMG, Dell, Palo Alto Networks, IHS Markit.
Faculty largely PhD holders, described as highly qualified and providing quality education.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category by far (2.0/5) — the most consistent complaint among reviewers relative to fees paid.
Some students explicitly express dissatisfaction with institute management, even while praising infrastructure.
Rated lower (3.6/5) compared to infra and campus life, suggesting curriculum or teaching delivery concerns for some students.

conclusion: Sentiment toward ABV-IIITM Gwalior is net positive, anchored by solid placements, strong infrastructure, and a good alumni network. However, sentiment is noticeably weaker than peer IIITs due to a sharply low Value for Money score (2.0/5) and some criticism of institute management.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
